City of Encinitas
Commission for the Arts
AGENDA
MARCH 4, 2024 -
05:00 PM
City of Encinitas - Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Ave
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the Commission.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS Welcome newly appointed commissioners and introduce staff.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF Each speaker has three (3) minutes to address the Commission for the Arts. There are no time donations during Oral Communications. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the Clerk. Direction to staff to bring back a future agenda item or provide additional information to answer a question requires consent of at least two Commission Members.
6.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announce administrative changes to the agenda in compliance with the Brown Act.
7.
APPROVAL OF THE MINUTES
1.
Approve the January 8, 2024, special meeting minutes.
January 8, 2024 special meeting minutes
2.
Approve the February 5, 2024, regular meeting minutes.
February 5, 2024 regular meeting minutes
8.
ACTION ITEMS
8A.
Commission for the Arts Chair and Vice Chair.
Commission, by motion, elect a Chair and Vice Chair to serve one-year terms for 2024-25.
8A. Commission for the Arts Chair and Vice Chair
8B.
Commission for the Arts 2024-25 Proposed Meeting Dates.
Review and adopt the proposed 2024-25 Commission for the Arts meeting dates.
8B. Commission for the Arts 2024-25 Proposed Meeting Dates
8C.
Public Art Sculpture Loan Recommendations.
1.
Review the sculptures recommended by the jurying panel along with the community survey ratings and comments for each.
2.
Vote to recommend one (1) sculpture for each of the five (5) pedestals to City Council for their approval of a two-year loan to the City.
3.
Consider the potential addition of a sixth sculpture location without a pedestal at Pacific View Arts Center and recommend one (1) sculpture for the site to City Council for their approval of a one-year loan to the City.
8C. Public Art Sculpture Loan Recommendations
8D.
Commission for the Arts Annual Work Plan.
1.
Discuss the FY 2023-24 Work Plan (Attachment 1), provide updates on status, and review final outcomes.
2.
Appoint one commissioner to serve on the Cultural Tourism Committee as liaison to the commission.
3.
Appoint one commissioner to serve on the Art Night Planning ad hoc committee to fill the vacancy.
4.
Form a Pacific View Public Art ad hoc committee and appoint up to three commissioners to serve on the jury panel for a new site-specific temporary public art installation.
5.
Suggest and discuss potential items for the FY 2024-25 draft Work Plan (Attachment 2) that align with the Arts Division’s projects and programs (Attachment 3) and City Council priorities.
8D. Commission for the Arts Annual Work Plan
8E.
Pacific View Arts Center.
Receive and file the City’s report.
8E. Pacific View Arts Center
8D.
Commission for the Arts Annual Work Plan.
9.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
9A.
Cultural Arts Division Report – Arts Administrator Murphy
9B.
Commission Calendar -- Arts Administrator Murphy
1.
Wednesdays@Noon: March 6, 13, 20, and 27, 2024, Encinitas Library
2.
Music by the Sea: March 22, 2024, at 7:30 p.m., Encinitas Library
3.
Art Night: March 9, various locations in Encinitas
10.
COMMISSION MEMBER-INITIATED AGENDA ITEM
10A.
Theater Pad at Encinitas Ranch Town Center – initiated by Commissioner Hebert
This item seeks agreement among the full Arts Commission on the wording of a letter to the City Council, as well as agreement to have the chairman send the letter to council on behalf of the commission once consensus on the letter is reached.
10A. Theater Pad at Encinitas Ranch Town Center
11.
FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS ADDED BY COMMISSION MEMBERS Future agenda items may be request with consensus of two or more Commissioners.
12.
COMMISSIONERS’ REPORTS
